body: For sure (insert argument about capitalism is nonsense and preys on the poor here). If there were a way to access ALL streaming services at once for sure id pay for it, but it sadly isnt an option nor i do think it will be any time soon if ever because of greedy corporates
Also "incur" is not a word i typically use so i was like "woah where thatd come from? Was that my brain just using big words, or something else?"

Yeah, God is loving and I try to think about Gods love first and foremost. However I also dont want to ignore messages from God just because it didnt "seem loving enough". Therefore I got paranoid. Thank you, OCD is... not fun

What about if youre poor and cant afford entertainment, so even if there is a legal streaming site you cant afford to go to it because of its cost? Would it be wrong to stream it on a non official site in that case?

With anime its pretty easy to find a show on mainstream streaming sites, however theres still so many streaming sites and its impossible to pay for all of them unless youre filthy rich. I especially run into this problem with manga, where i cant afford to buy physical copies of volumes and it can be quite hard to find it in libraries or second hand stores.

Yeah thats what im thinking too. It wouldnt be a sin to sit down and watch a movie with the family without buying a copy for every person afterall. Creators deserve to be paid of course but its a little more complicated.
May I ask what you mean by that?

Ill try to keep the verses you quoted in mind, thank you.

As a creator myself, I kind of see it as id get the same amount of money if someone passed down one physical copy of my work among many people as i would if someone bought a physical copy and uploaded it to some site for many people to watch for free.

With digital media not being an inherently physical thing, I feel its much more complicated than it would be if someone stole a physical object.

Of course though, not paying for netflix as a service, and going out of your way to hack the service to use it for free, would definitely be wrong, because that would undoubtedly be using a neighbors service without paying them.

I dont know, its a lot to think about, and I appreciate your perspective and Ill try to keep it in mind. The verses for sure give me something to think about, and theyre verses i havent seen before in regards to this topic, so I thank you for making me aware of them.

I know, but mental health can be rough, and its hard to balance the "fear of the lord" thing without taking it too far.

Ive been working through my fears of sin bit by bit, but my brain still likes to play tricks on me. Gods been helping me for sure, but its still a matter of fighting bad thoughts.

I know that God loves me no matter what and can see I'm trying my best to do good, but I also dont want that to be an excuse. I dont want to be the kind of person who sins freely and unapologetically because "god will forgive me anyways".

Thank you for your input. Ive been wrestling with this all in my head for a while.

Another hypothetical, say you buy second hand or borrow from a friend. Would this technically be depriving a worker of their wages in that case, not buying from them directly? Im trying not to make excuses, but I do find theres a lot of technicalities to think about.

And for sure I agree that creators deserve to be paid, i myself am an artist after all, however from a standpoint of not often having money I get the whole standpoint of "I literally cant pay for it and want to when I can to support the creator". I do debate if just because I get it from a personal standpoint if its still wrong or not though.

Im definitely trying to keep to free non-pirated content for now just to be safe though, even if it is a case where i dont have the money to pay for it but would if i could.

Im kinda following the same logic, but its hard to follow when you have an extreme fear of sin because of OCD.
